انكتبت (form VII)
# اِنْكَتَبْتُ (inkatabtu) /in.ka.tab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# اِنْكَتَبْتَ (inkatabta) /in.ka.tab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# اِنْكَتَبْتِ (inkatabti) /in.ka.tab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْكَتَبَ (inkataba)
# اِنْكَتَبَتْ (inkatabat) /in.ka.ta.bat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
